verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an email client like Outlook, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The closest item, a community note about advertising preferences on free accounts, concerns ads rather than telemetry control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
